summary.text: As Department of War Chief Information Officer, Kirsten A. Davies said AI has increased the sophistication of attacks and the data available to attackers. She discussed AI in relation to upskilling the workforce and said integrating AI supports modernization directives. She also referenced laying the groundwork for secure AI and listed AI implementation as part of Program Arcadia. In supplied statements, she said the department needs to execute on data analytics and AI and to embed the building blocks of AI.
